summary: @ornikar/storybook-config 12.1.3 ships preinstall dropper that fetches Bun runtime to execute bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs is written with obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and property-lookup indirection wrappers around every native call. When executed on `npm install`, it checks for a local `bun` binary and, if absent, downloads the Bun runtime zip from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<arch>.zip` to a temp directory, extracts it, chmods it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [math_init.js])`. The sibling `math_init.js` is a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` compiled bundle with a shuffled string-array dispatcher and numeric-encoded literal table, unreadable to standard Node review. Neither the alternate-runtime download nor the bundled Bun payload has any relation to the package's advertised purpose (a Storybook configuration preset). Version 12.1.3 is absent from the shipped CHANGELOG.md (last entry 12.1.1); the preinstall hook, setup.mjs, and math_init.js are new in this release and were not present in prior versions of the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
